question: In the morning, a shop had 23 items. They doubled. They spent 29 items. They added 29. By afternoon, they divided by 2. By evening, how many items?
A baker had 40 cookies. She added 32 more. She multiplied by 3 for packaging. She divided by 3 for individual servings. She multiplied by 6 for a party order. How many cookies are needed?
In the morning, a factory had 232 items. They added 48. They multiplied by 8. The work took 120 minutes, or 2 hours. By afternoon, they added 23. By evening, they added 16. How many items?

A food truck started the morning with 153 dollars in the cash box. By midmorning, 48 dollars were spent restocking napkins, and a lunch rush added 33 more dollars. In the afternoon, 68 more dollars came in from a catering order, and a matching bonus doubled that afternoon total. Since the truck logs sales in dollars but the tax form requires cents, the owner always converted the numbers before filing. That evening, 30 more dollars came in from a dinner rush. Overnight, a final tip added 67 more dollars. How much money was in the cash box the next morning?

Two friends, Marisol and Deng, keep separate coin jars, but this story follows only Marisol's jar, which started at 13 dollars, less than Deng's jar held. A birthday gift added 59 more dollars. A matching gift then doubled her jar. The money was then split evenly among 6 smaller envelopes, and this story follows just one envelope. Finally, 9 dollars were spent on a gift from that envelope. How much money was in that one envelope in the end?

Maria started a savings fund with 112 dollars. She tripled her savings by picking up overtime shifts. Then her parents gave her 50 dollars as a gift. Her aunt sent another 80 dollars for her birthday. Maria then invested all her money, which grew ninefold by year-end. She divided the final amount equally among 3 college funds. What is the total amount in each fund?
A worker had 136 boxes in storage. They removed 2 boxes, then 102 more for shipment, added back 7, and gained 72 from a delivery. Converting to hours of work time, how many hours are represented?

In the morning, a shop started with 151 items. By midday, 79 items were sold. By afternoon, they received 25 items. By evening, their inventory increased 7 times. They increased 9 times. Finally, they increased 4 times. Converting to tens (1 bundle = 10), how many items? A competitor had 50000 items.

Marek began the month with 77 bus tokens in his wallet, and his route passes 14 stops on the way to work. Commuting used up 66 of the tokens, and he gave 8 of them to a visiting friend. He took what was left to the transport office, where each token was converted into 7 ride credits. He then spent 20 of those credits travelling at the weekend. The office upgraded every credit he still held into 6 bonus credits, and he used 5 of the bonus credits on the Monday after. How many credits does Marek have now?

In the morning Farah's shop had 63 umbrellas; a delivery of 61 arrived, then a second supplier brought 65 more, and she moved every umbrella onto the front display. In the afternoon 18 umbrellas were sold from the display. In the evening a storm broke and 140 umbrellas were sold. Her rival Gabe, across the street, sold fewer umbrellas than Farah that day. How many umbrellas are left on Farah's front display?
A warehouse started with 216 units. They removed 49. They multiplied by 8. They added 27. They added 4 more. They removed 1,028. They multiplied by 5. How many units remain?

A launderette records its wash cycles in hours rather than in minutes. On Monday morning 4 machines were each loaded with 164 towels. Before lunch a hotel sent over 16 more towels for the same job. During the afternoon 335 towels were collected by their owners. In the evening head office asked all 6 of its branches to hold the same number of towels as this branch had left. How many towels do the 6 branches hold in total?
A warehouse had 129 boxes. They multiplied by 8 to 1,032. They divided in half to 516. They divided by 6 to 86. They added 33, reaching 119. They removed 100, leaving 19 boxes. How many boxes remain?

A business had 141 items. They lost 117 items. They gained 17 items. They gained 47 more. They multiplied by 8. They had 9 locations needing stock. They sold 135 items. They gained 22 items. How many do they have?

On Monday morning a paper mill had 184 bales of pulp, and 72 bales were sent to another mill. In the afternoon each remaining bale was pressed into 7 rolls, and every roll was cut into 4 reams. In the evening 286 reams were damaged by water, and the next day 2277 reams were sold to a printer. Each ream that is left will be cut into 7 pads of paper. The mill employs 130 people. How many pads of paper will the mill make?

A bakery started with 56 loaves of bread. They multiplied production by 7, added 67 loaves, multiplied by 7 again, divided into 3 sections for distribution, and added 19 loaves for reserve. How many loaves are there?

Priya tracks her swimming in metres, converting any distance her coach gives in kilometres into metres before it goes into her log. On Monday morning she swam 8 sets of 165 metres each. In the afternoon she added a cool-down of 20 metres, and in the evening she swam another 56 metres. She repeated exactly the same Monday programme on each of 4 days that week. On the last of those days she finished the evening session with a final 10 metres of gentle backstroke. How many metres did Priya swim in total that week?

Two gardeners pooled efforts. Starting total: 167 plants. Added 59 new starts. Subtracted 37 that died. Added 20 hardy varieties. Multiplied by 5 for garden one. Multiplied by 5 for garden two. Subtracted 780 overcounted. How many plants actually planted?

A cider maker had 173 bottles racked in the cellar and a friend brought round 31 more. A second pressing then tripled the number of bottles in the cellar. All of them were packed equally into 4 crates ready for the market. A delivery van took 28 bottles out of the first crate on the way. How many bottles are in that first crate now?

Bea had 19 boxes of tiles in her hallway, and a delivery brought 34 more. A friend gave her 8 boxes, and a clearance sale added 67 more. Each box holds 3 packs, and every pack holds 2 tiles. Bea now has more boxes than her brother Milo has in his garage. How many tiles does Bea have?
A factory had 218 units. They multiplied by 4. They multiplied by 8. They added 40. They added 79 more. How many units were produced?

A museum gift shop had 227 postcards in stock, and 1 was torn and thrown away. The rest were divided equally between the shop's 2 counters. The front counter sold 78 postcards on Saturday. A printer then delivered 74 new postcards to the front counter. How many postcards are on the front counter?

A factory started with 142 units. They multiplied production 5 times by adding a second shift. They added 25 more units. They tripled the entire output for bulk orders, making it grow 7 times. Then they shipped 4,332 units. How many units remain?

In the morning, a factory had 155 chairs assembled, even though the factory has a dozen assembly lines. By midday, three more matching production lines made the total four times as large. In the afternoon, four more matching lines made it five times as large. By evening, 33 more chairs came from a late run. Later, 1,666 chairs were shipped out for a big order. Finally, 45 more chairs were added from a returned shipment. How many chairs did the factory have by the end of the day?

The bakery had 15 boxes, each with 2 layers of 9 muffins, and stacked all the muffins on the counter. It sold 146 muffins and gave 25 away as samples. Then 73 fresh muffins were added to the counter. How many muffins are on the counter?
